main.description: Sets the complete display order of a community's categories.

community.description: The community whose categories are being reordered.

categories.description: The complete new display order of the community's categories.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the category.update permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The supplied categories do not match the community's existing set.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.
